what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Nepal in the United States: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6426 Nepalese asylum seekers in the United States, 44.1% of all asylum seekers from Nepal.
Refugees from Nepal, a separate group, live mostly in the United States, Canada, France and Portugal.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nepal with the CPN-M from 1996 to 2006.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2017 to 2024, come after that conflict ended.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 123 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 13156, at the end of 2024.
It was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for the United States only.
